DESIGN_NOTE_entity_positive_signal.observation: canonicalById (index.ts ~4769) is a real per-turn RLS-scoped DB read of contextPack rows (companies, people, projects, tasks, goals, approvals), declared in the SAME scope as the belt and ~900 lines before it. A set of known entity NAMES is derivable there at zero extra cost.
DESIGN_NOTE_entity_positive_signal.proposal: Use known names as a POSITIVE signal only, exactly as verifier #30 suggested: a capitalised run that equals a known entity name is a NAME (nameInternal true; status-guard subject true) and never a determiner reading. Truncation-safe because absence proves nothing and is never used.
what_it_resolves: "No North Depot was archived." - preserved when no such entity exists, caught when one does
"Confirmed - Archived Media Group. It is still active." - preserved when Archived Media Group is a known company (the truth direction, the worse failure direction)
"Nothing Bundt Cakes was archived." - caught when the company exists
DESIGN_NOTE_entity_positive_signal.what_stays_lexical: a fabrication about a name that does NOT exist in the workspace: on an ungrounded turn the fabricated entity is never in contextPack (verifier #30 noted this), so the D188 minimal pair and lowercase bare names remain regex-bound.
DESIGN_NOTE_entity_positive_signal.cost_and_risk: A name set referenced INSIDE the belt block collides with the extractor suites (run15-run19, v92_open_regression_contract): verifier #36 measured that a referenced top-level const outside the block takes 7/10 suites to ReferenceError. The set must be threaded in a form the brace-balanced extractors tolerate (e.g. read at call time from a closure variable the harnesses can stub), which is a harness change as well as a belt change. Not attempted while a verifier is running; proposed for the round after #38.
DESIGN_NOTE_entity_positive_signal.why_now: Verifier #38 was asked whether the belt has reached the floor of a regex approach. This is the answer if it says yes: the remaining residuals separate on world knowledge, and the world knowledge is already in scope.
